title: Historical GitHub JSON receipts are not parseable canonical JSON
title_de: Historische GitHub-JSON-Receipts sind kein parsebares kanonisches JSON
summary: Earlier JSON-suffixed GitHub summary receipts contained literal trailing \\n; a separate reconciled JSON snapshot was required.
summary_de: Frühere JSON-suffigierte GitHub-Summary-Receipts enthielten ein literales trailing \\n; ein separates reconciled JSON snapshot war erforderlich.
observed_behavior: Earlier JSON-suffixed GitHub summary receipts contained literal trailing \\n; a separate reconciled JSON snapshot was required.
observed_behavior_de: Frühere JSON-suffigierte GitHub-Summary-Receipts enthielten ein literales trailing \\n; ein separates reconciled JSON snapshot war erforderlich.
expected_behavior: Current evidence must be rerun against a known revision before this finding can advance beyond validated.
expected_behavior_de: Die aktuelle Evidence muss gegen eine bekannte Revision erneut ausgeführt werden, bevor dieses Finding über validated hinaus fortschreiten kann.
impact: Release and assurance claims remain bounded by the recorded evidence.
impact_de: Release- und Assurance-Aussagen bleiben durch die dokumentierte Evidence begrenzt.
preconditions: The retained assessment evidence and its referenced revision remain available.
root_cause: The retained evidence identifies the condition but does not establish a product-code root cause.
root_cause_de: Die retained Evidence belegt den Zustand, aber keine Produktcode-Grundursache.
proposed_remediation: Make the artifact writer emit parseable canonical JSON at production time and preserve the raw original separately.
proposed_remediation_de: Den Artifact-Writer so korrigieren, dass er parsebares kanonisches JSON erzeugt, und das Raw-Original getrennt bewahren.
acceptance_criteria: A newly produced GitHub receipt parses as canonical JSON without reconciliation.
The raw receipt and its reconciled derivative are traceable by SHA-256.
validation_plan: Run the GitHub evidence writer in a safe read-only fixture.
Parse its emitted JSON with jq and retain the exact output.
regression_tests: Add or retain a focused regression/evidence control for the recorded condition.
legitimate_control_tests: Run the unaffected allow/control behavior in the same scoped environment.
residual_risk: The condition remains open; no risk has been accepted by the current user.
residual_risk_de: Der Zustand bleibt offen; der aktuelle Benutzer hat kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: Created by the one-time finding-management bootstrap from retained evidence; no remediation, verification, closure, or risk acceptance was performed.
